seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Boulder City, NV 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Boulder City, NV: Santa Train, North Pole Express, Santa's Picture Party, electric night parade and the Lake Mead Parade of Lights.
lede: Boulder City does Christmas on a small-town scale: Santa trains at the Nevada State Railroad Museum, a downtown electric night parade, a gazebo Santa party and a lighted boat parade on Lake Mead.
celebrates: Boulder City celebrates in its historic streets and along Lake Mead, a short drive from the Las Vegas valley. The Nevada State Railroad Museum runs the daytime Santa Train and the evening North Pole Express. The city and the Boulder City Chamber of Commerce host a community tree lighting at Frank Crowe Park, Santa's Picture Party at the Bicentennial Park Gazebo and Santa's Electric Night Parade through the Historic District, where floats, marching bands, Santa and Mrs. Claus roll by. The Parade of Lights brings decorated boats to Lake Mead Marina, with Santa on the docks. The library adds a Christmas magic show, and adults get the Best Dam Wine Walk downtown.
lastyear: In 2025 the Nevada State Railroad Museum ran its North Pole Express in the evening, including a trip on November 29, and listed it as sold out. Coach seats were $35 for adults and $30 for children. Families took a 30 minute train ride with holiday sing-alongs and a reading of Twas the Night Before Christmas, then got off at Santa's Railyard for cookies and hot chocolate, games and a snowball fight. The museum said the event was operated as a fundraiser for the Friends of the Nevada Southern Railway.
facts: Boulder City sits beside Hoover Dam, and its wartime history is part of the story. The National Park Service says a U.S. Army post was established in Boulder City in 1941 to protect the dam from enemy sabotage, staffed by a battalion of military police that at its peak included 27 officers and more than 700 enlisted men. Basic Magnesium employed up to 14,000 workers in the Henderson and Boulder City area. The Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority says the Santa Trains have been a family tradition since 2002.
trains: Boulder City is the train town of southern Nevada. The Nevada State Railroad Museum, at 1000 Boulder City Parkway, runs the daytime Santa Train, a 45 minute ride the museum lists at $12 per person and $6 for members, with Santa and his helpers handing out candy canes and posing for photos. The evening North Pole Express adds sing-alongs and a stop at Santa's Railyard for cookies, hot chocolate and games, and the museum lists it as sold out for 2026. Tickets for the Santa Train are first come, first served.

faq: What is the Santa Train in Boulder City?

The Santa Train is the Nevada State Railroad Museum's daytime holiday ride. Passengers climb aboard a vintage railroad car for a 45 minute journey with Christmas songs, candy canes from Santa's helpers and photos with Santa. The Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority says the tradition began in 2002, and tickets are first come, first served.
Is the North Pole Express in Boulder City sold out?

The museum lists all 2026 North Pole Express tickets as sold out. The ride is an evening trip of about 90 minutes, including a 30 minute train ride with sing-alongs and a reading of Twas the Night Before Christmas, followed by cookies, hot chocolate and games at Santa's Railyard.
Where can kids meet Santa in Boulder City?

Kids can meet Santa on the Santa Train, at Santa's Picture Party at the Bicentennial Park Gazebo, in Santa's Electric Night Parade, on the docks at the Parade of Lights at Lake Mead Marina and aboard the North Pole Express. Check each host's page for dates and times before you go.
Is there a Christmas parade in Boulder City?

Yes. Santa's Electric Night Parade winds through the Historic District, from Nevada Way and Colorado Street to 5th Street and Avenue B. The city and the visitors authority describe lit floats, marching bands, live performances and holiday music, with Santa and Mrs. Claus in the parade.
Is there a boat parade near Boulder City?

Yes. The Parade of Lights is a Lake Mead tradition now in its 48th year. Boats decorated in Christmas lights come to docks at Lake Mead Marina, where visitors can walk the docks, visit Santa and vote for their favorite boats in four classes. A Best in Show winner receives $500.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Boulder City for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Santa Train and North Pole Express at the Nevada State Railroad Museum) through December 20, with the Community Tree Lighting at Frank Crowe Park (December 4), Santa's Electric Night Parade (December 5) and the Parade of Lights at Lake Mead Marina (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Boulder City

  • Parades and tree lightings: Community Tree Lighting at Frank Crowe Park, Santa's Electric Night Parade and the Parade of Lights
  • Trains: Santa Train and North Pole Express at the Nevada State Railroad Museum (North Pole Express is sold out)
